content.text: No transition or data-return provision exists anywhere. Let me validate an insertion into the termination article.

input.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide transition assistance and return Company Content and customer/order data on termination, then certify deletion.
input.comment: [Playbook] The termination article is silent on exit, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: up to six months' assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our Content and customer/order data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback, but we need the data-return and deletion mechanics in order to migrate the Site without disruption.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including migration of the Site and the URL, for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer and order data relating to the Site or the Deerskin Products, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.
